changeSet.author: loco-place
changeSet.comment: Prioritize Rental, then Transfer, then Cleaning in the customer service catalog.
changeSet.sql: update platform_service_state set display_order = case service when 'RENTAL' then 10 when 'TRANSFER' then 20 when 'CLEANING' then 30 else display_order end, updated_at = current_timestamp, updated_by_customer_id = null, version = version + 1 where service in ('RENTAL', 'TRANSFER', 'CLEANING');

rollback.sql: update platform_service_state set display_order = case service when 'CLEANING' then 10 when 'RENTAL' then 20 when 'TRANSFER' then 30 else display_order end, updated_at = current_timestamp, updated_by_customer_id = null, version = version + 1 where service in ('RENTAL', 'TRANSFER', 'CLEANING');
